score_scale.note: 4 = best on this dimension under the frozen evidence rules

dimensions.name: content/existence/metadata isolation
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: ISO1/ISO2 counters over accepted fixture runs; deny-equivalence across all equivalence classes; timing signal versus frozen tolerance

dimensions.name: correctness of authorization placement (authorize before materialize)
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: materialize_before_policy_check counter = 0 and policy check precedes any row materialization on every allow path

dimensions.name: cache invalidation and revoke/move behavior
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: ISO3/ISO4 counters across revoke/move/supersede cases; number of invalidation commit operations per event; stale-entry detections

dimensions.name: projection/provenance integrity
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: ISO5 counter; share of retrieved entries carrying the complete provenance tuple plus canonical scope binding after projection/retrieval

dimensions.name: bulk/pagination/background-job isolation
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: ISO6 counter over bulk, pagination, aggregation and background reindex observations

dimensions.name: failure blast radius
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured in-model: number of scopes able to observe a corrupted/misprojected index entry (corrupt-entry fault injection through the real retrieval paths)

dimensions.name: auditability and counterexample quality
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: audit completeness (allow/deny events for every request, no protected data in audit bodies) plus whether counterexamples remain visible per raw observation without aggregation

dimensions.name: deterministic testing/replay
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: identical bytes for identical seed reruns; number of distinct decision paths needing coverage per variant (fewer = simpler adversarial coverage)

dimensions.name: operational complexity and migration cost
dimensions.evidence_rule: inference from the frozen contract: number of runtime components on the retrieval path, number of index objects to create/migrate, and whether the current gateway-only memory scoping can adopt the contract without core changes; source-bound, not vendor marketing

dimensions.name: storage/latency/resource overhead in the local model
dimensions.evidence_rule: measured: index entry counts and payload bytes, rows scanned and policy predicate evaluations per retrieval, cache behavior under the frozen workload. Directional scoring is FROZEN as inverse normalization: for each cost component score = 4 * min(component value across candidates) / value(candidate), so the candidate with the LOWER measured cost always receives the strictly higher component score (the costliest value can never receive the maximum unless all values are equal); the per-component scores are averaged

dimensions.name: profile compatibility and residual risk
dimensions.evidence_rule: inference from the threat model and source profiles: compatibility with profiles A+/B and the documented profile-C boundary (admin-blind indexing is S1-018 scope; a contract that requires it now is incompatible)

hard_constraints: ISO1-ISO8 counters equal zero on every accepted honest-variant fixture run; any violation is FAIL regardless of weighted score
authorize before materialize holds on every allow path of both variants
deny bodies are byte-identical across all equivalence classes for the accepted variants
provenance plus canonical scope binding present on every disclosed object
no production, availability, latency-SLO or privacy-certification claims are derived from this local model

tie_policy.rule: if |score_a - score_b| < 0.05 prefer the candidate with fewer dimensions scored as unknown; if still tied the verdict is capped at PASS_WITH_LIMITS and a profile split must be explicitly justified

unknown_policy.rule: unknown/NO_DATA cells are excluded from the weighted base score, bounded by [pessimistic, optimistic] in sensitivity analysis, and never counted as zero, as an average or as an advantage

sensitivity_policy.weight_perturbation: each weight set to 50% and 150% of its base value (renormalized), all pairwise one-at-a-time
sensitivity_policy.random_vectors: 200 deterministic seeded weight vectors (seed 42) over the simplex
sensitivity_policy.unknown_bounds: every unknown cell swung between its pessimistic and optimistic bounds
sensitivity_policy.verdict_rule: any winner flip under the perturbations caps the verdict at PASS_WITH_LIMITS and the flip set is reported verbatim
